body: Portuguese drone maker Beyond Vision has closed a €28 million Series A funding round, led by Lisbon-based venture firms Índico Capital Partners and Lince Capital, with existing shareholder ActiveCap also taking part. The company develops dual-use drones and AI-driven systems for remote operation and swarm operations.

The funding will be used to accelerate growth, notably by doubling the size of its production facility at Alverca do Ribatejo, near Lisbon, with a target of producing 500 to 800 drones per month. The company also plans to further develop its cloud-based remote drone operation platform, beXStream, and its swarm coordination technology, and has recently entered the naval drone market.

Founded in 2013, Beyond Vision has become a significant company in Portugal's aerospace industry. The Portuguese Armed Forces were among its early customers, although most of its output is now exported, and the company plans to expand its presence in the United States, where its emergency-response drones have drawn interest from local companies. Its drones have also been used in Ukraine, where the war highlighted the importance of drones of all kinds on the modern battlefield.
en.summary: Portuguese drone maker Beyond Vision has raised €28 million in a Series A round led by Índico Capital Partners and Lince Capital, and will use the funding to double its production facility near Lisbon and develop its remote-operation and swarm technologies.
en.title: Portuguese drone maker Beyond Vision closes €28 million Series A round

body: 葡萄牙無人機製造商Beyond Vision完成2800萬歐元Series A融資，本輪由里斯本創投公司Índico Capital Partners與Lince Capital領投，既有股東ActiveCap亦參與。該公司開發軍民兩用無人機，以及可遠端操控與蜂群操作的AI驅動系統。
這筆資金將用於加速成長，重點是將位於里斯本附近Alverca do Ribatejo的生產設施規模擴大一倍，目標每月生產500至800架無人機。公司也將進一步發展雲端遠端無人機操控平台beXStream與蜂群協調技術，近期亦已進入海軍無人機市場。
Beyond Vision成立於2013年，已成為葡萄牙航太產業的重要企業。葡萄牙武裝部隊是其早期客戶之一，但目前多數產量出口，公司亦計畫擴大在美國的布局，其緊急應變無人機已引起當地公司興趣。報導也提到，其無人機已在烏克蘭使用，而烏克蘭戰爭凸顯了各類無人機在現代戰場的重要性。
zh.summary: 葡萄牙無人機製造商Beyond Vision完成2800萬歐元Series A融資，由Índico Capital Partners與Lince Capital領投，資金將用於擴大里斯本附近的生產設施並發展遠端操控與蜂群技術。
